```{r hill_long to sampledata, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
hill_wide <- hill_long %>%
  rename(sample = id) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_prefix = "env_hill_q",
    id_cols      = sample,
    names_from   = q,
    values_from  = value
  )

sample_metadata <- sample_metadata %>%
  left_join(hill_wide, by = "sample")
```

```{r hill_loop, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
hill_info <- tribble(
  # the original q identifier (not really used below, you can even drop it)
  ~q,  
  # these must exactly match the names in your hill_wide/meta
  ~hill_col,                ~group_col,         ~outname,
  "0", "env_hill_qhill_q0",  "env_div_group0",    "q0",
  "1", "env_hill_qhill_q1",  "env_div_group1",    "q1",
  "2", "env_hill_qhill_q2",  "env_div_group2",    "q2"
)



filtered_inputs <- hill_info %>%
  pmap(function(q, hill_col, group_col, outname) {
    md <- sample_metadata %>%
      mutate(
        !!group_col := cut_number(.data[[hill_col]], 3, labels = c("Low","Mid","High"))
      ) %>%
      filter(.data[[group_col]] %in% c("Low","High"))

    # Keep only genomes present in ≥1 of those samples
    sel <- md$sample
    gc <- genome_counts_filt %>%
      select(genome, any_of(sel)) %>%
      filter(if_any(-genome, ~ .x > 0))

    list(
      q             = q,
      hill_col      = hill_col,
      group_col     = group_col,
      metadata_div  = md,
      genome_counts = gc
    )
  }) %>%
  set_names(hill_info$outname)
```


```{r env_structuralzeros, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
structural_zeros_list <- map(filtered_inputs, function(f) {
  md <- f$metadata_div
  gc <- f$genome_counts

  # 1) Which samples are Low vs High?
  low_samps  <- md$sample[md[[f$group_col]] == "Low"]
  high_samps <- md$sample[md[[f$group_col]] == "High"]

  # 2) Keep only samples that actually appear in gc
  low_samps  <- intersect(low_samps,  colnames(gc))
  high_samps <- intersect(high_samps, colnames(gc))

  # 3) Make a matrix with genomes as rownames
  mat <- gc %>%
    column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
    as.matrix()

  # 4) Compute “all zero” flags and group means
  all_low_zero  <- rowSums(mat[, low_samps,  drop = FALSE]) == 0
  all_high_zero <- rowSums(mat[, high_samps, drop = FALSE]) == 0
  avg_low       <- rowMeans(mat[, low_samps,  drop = FALSE])
  avg_high      <- rowMeans(mat[, high_samps, drop = FALSE])

  # 5) Build the tibble, filter to structural zeros, and label
  tibble(
    genome   = rownames(mat),
    all_low  = all_low_zero,
    all_high = all_high_zero,
    avg_low  = avg_low,
    avg_high = avg_high
  ) %>%
    filter(all_low | all_high) %>%
    transmute(
      genome,
      present = case_when(
        all_low  & !all_high ~ "High",
        all_high & !all_low  ~ "Low",
        TRUE                ~ NA_character_
      ),
      average = if_else(present == "High", avg_high, avg_low)
    )
})

```


```{r env_chart1, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# Define colors for the two groups
groupcolors <- c('#408892','#c04062')  # for Low, High

# Loop *over names(filtered_inputs)*, which will be c("q0","q1","q2")
for(qname in names(filtered_inputs)) {
  f <- filtered_inputs[[qname]]
  
  # Extract relevant objects
  group_col <- f$group_col                  # e.g. "env_div_group0"
  metadata_div <- f$metadata_div            # filtered metadata for Low & High
  genome_counts <- f$genome_counts          # counts table with only those samples
  
  # Generate presence/absence: genomes as rows, samples as columns
  genome_pa <- genome_counts %>%
    column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    `>`(0) %>%
    `*`(1)
  
  # Which samples are "Low", which are "High"?
  groupings <- metadata_div[[group_col]]
  
  # Create logical vectors for group assignment
  low_samples  <- metadata_div$sample[groupings == "Low"]
  high_samples <- metadata_div$sample[groupings == "High"]
  
  # Aggregate: 1 if present in any sample in the group, 0 otherwise
  Low  <- as.integer(rowSums(genome_pa[,low_samples, drop=FALSE])  > 0)
  High <- as.integer(rowSums(genome_pa[,high_samples, drop=FALSE]) > 0)
  
  table_upset_analysis <- data.frame(Low=Low, High=High)
  rownames(table_upset_analysis) <- rownames(genome_pa)
  
  # UpSet plot
  cat("Plotting UpSet for", qname, "\n")
  upset(
    table_upset_analysis,
    sets = c("Low", "High"),
    sets.bar.color = groupcolors,
    keep.order = TRUE,
    mb.ratio = c(0.55, 0.45),
    order.by = "freq",
    main.bar.color = "gray30",
    mainbar.y.label = paste("Genomes (", qname, ")", sep=""),
    sets.x.label = "Number of genomes"
  )
}
```

```{r env_phyloseqobject, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
group_colors <- c(Low  = "#408892", High = "#c04062")

walk2(filtered_inputs, names(filtered_inputs), ~{
  f    <- .x
  name <- .y

  md <- f$metadata_div
  gc <- f$genome_counts %>% column_to_rownames("genome")
  pa <- (gc > 0) * 1

  sets <- md %>% 
    split(.$env_div_group0) %>%   # actually use f$group_col
    map(~.$sample)

  cat("UpSet for q=", name, "\n")
  upset(
    as.data.frame(pa),
    sets            = c("Low","High"),
    sets.bar.color  = group_colors,
    keep.order      = TRUE,
    mb.ratio        = c(0.6,0.4),
    mainbar.y.label = paste("Genomes present (q", name, ")", sep=""),
    sets.x.label    = "Genomes per group"
  )
})
```

#### MAG level

```{r env_ancombc, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
phylo_list <- imap(filtered_inputs, function(f, name) {
  md <- f$metadata_div %>% column_to_rownames("sample")
  otu <- f$genome_counts %>%
    mutate(across(-genome, ~replace(.x, .x==0, 1e-5))) %>%
    column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
    otu_table(taxa_are_rows=TRUE)

  tax <- genome_metadata %>%
    filter(genome %in% rownames(otu)) %>%
    select(domain:species, genome) %>%
    column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    tax_table()

  phyloseq(otu, tax, sample_data(md))
})
```

```{r env_ancombc_visulasation, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ancom_results <- imap(phylo_list, function(ps, name) {
  fixf <- paste0("~", filtered_inputs[[name]]$group_col)
  message("ANCOMBC2 for q=", name)
  tryCatch(
    ancombc2(ps, assay_name="counts", tax_level=NULL,
            fix_formula=fixf, struc_zero=FALSE,
            p_adj_method="holm", verbose=FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      warning("ANCOMBC2 failed for q=", name, ": ", e$message)
      NULL
    }
  )
})
```

```{r env_ancombc_rand_plot_phy, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=8, fig.fullwidth=TRUE}
da_tables <- imap(ancom_results, function(res, name) {
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  dt <- res$res$diff_abn
  # dynamically detect columns
  lfc_col <- grep("^lfc_", names(dt), value=TRUE)[1]
  p_col   <- grep("^p_",   names(dt), value=TRUE)[1]

  sig <- dt %>%
    filter(.data[[p_col]] < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(.data[[p_col]]) %>%
    left_join(
      genome_metadata %>% select(genome, phylum),
      by="genome"
    )

  cat("\n### q=", name, ": top DA genomes\n")
  print(kable(head(sig,20)))
  sig
})
```

```{r env_ancom_rand_volcano, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = FALSE}
barplots <- imap(da_tables, function(sig, name) {
  if (is.null(sig) || nrow(sig)==0) return(NULL)
  ggplot(sig, aes(x=!!sym(lfc_col), y=fct_reorder(genome, !!sym(lfc_col)), fill=phylum)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
    labs(
      x     = "log2FC",
      y     = "Genome",
      title = paste("DA, Hill q=", name)
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
})

walk(barplots, print)
```

```{r env_ancom_rand_season, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = FALSE}
set.seed(1234)

# Loop over all q values for ANCOMBC2 with structural zero control
ancom_struczero_results <- imap(
  phyloseq_list,
  function(physeq, qname) {
    group_col <- filtered_inputs[[qname]]$group_col
    message(paste("Running ANCOMBC2 w/ structural zero estimation for q =", qname, " group_col:", group_col))
    tryCatch({
      ancombc2(
        data = physeq,
        assay_name = "counts", 
        tax_level = NULL, # or set as "species" etc if you want taxonomy collapse
        fix_formula = paste0("~", group_col),          
        rand_formula = "~1",
        p_adj_method = "holm", 
        pseudo_sens = TRUE,
        prv_cut =0, 
        lib_cut = 0, 
        s0_perc = 0.05,
        group = group_col,               
        struc_zero = TRUE,               
        neg_lb = FALSE,
        alpha = 0.05, 
        n_cl = 2, 
        verbose = TRUE,
        global = FALSE, 
        pairwise = FALSE, 
        dunnet = FALSE, 
        trend = FALSE,
        iter_control = list(tol = 1e-5, max_iter = 20, verbose = FALSE),
        em_control = list(tol = 1e-5, max_iter = 100),
        lme_control = lme4::lmerControl(),
        mdfdr_control = list(fwer_ctrl_method = "holm", B = 100), 
        trend_control = NULL
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("ANCOMBC2 (struc_zero) failed for ", qname, ": ", e$message))
      NULL
    })
  }
)
```

```{r env_ancom_rand1, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = FALSE}
colors_alphabetic <- read_tsv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/earthhologenome/EHI_taxonomy_colour/main/ehi_phylum_colors.tsv") %>%
  mutate(phylum = str_replace(phylum, "[dpcofgs]__", "")) %>%
  select(phylum, colors) %>%
  unique() %>%
  arrange(phylum)

ancom_struczero_tables <- imap(
  ancom_struczero_results,
  function(ancom, qname) {
    if(is.null(ancom)) return(NULL)
    taxonomy <- data.frame(tax_table(phyloseq_list[[qname]])) %>%
      rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
      mutate(across(c(order, phylum, family, genus, species), ~ str_replace(., "[dpcofgs]__", "")))

    # Identify LFC and P columns dynamically for your group variable (not hardcoding sexFemale)
    tab <- ancom$res$diff_abn
    lfc_col <- names(tab)[grepl("^lfc_", names(tab))]
    p_col <- names(tab)[grepl("^p_", names(tab))]
    lfc_col <- lfc_col[1]
    p_col <- p_col[1]

    # Merge and filter significant features
    ancom_tab <- tab %>%
      select(taxon, !!lfc_col, !!p_col) %>%
      filter(.data[[p_col]] < 0.05) %>%
      arrange(.data[[p_col]]) %>%
      merge(taxonomy, by = "taxon") %>%
      mutate_at(vars(phylum, species), ~ str_replace(., "[dpcofgs]__", "")) %>%
      arrange(.data[[lfc_col]])
```
